name: Goblin Games
about: Goblin Games is a one-person indie game studio. Its first game is The Last God, a dark-fantasy roguelite survivors-like.
blurb: Hi, I'm the goblin. One person, a hoard of shiny ideas, and a stubborn habit of finishing them.
I design and shape everything here; AI helps me build it, and I'll always tell you where.
The plan: get good games into your hands fast, then let you steer what comes next. Sales go back in, and my focus is real artists on the parts you love most.
